_hinweis: Erkennungsmusik für „Zwischen den Zeilen“. Erzeugt mit Eleven Music (kommerziell nutzbar ab Starter-Plan). Gleicher Stil für alle Stücke, damit die Folge wie aus einem Guss klingt. Neu erzeugen: node werkzeuge/musik.mjs --neu NAME. Seit 27.11.2026 Richtung „Gitarre“ (Neo-Soul-Beat mit E-Gitarren-Melodie und gedämpfter Trompete) – vom Herausgeber aus vier Richtungen gewählt („so geile Richtung“). Davor: Redaktions-Beat („okay, aber schon hundertmal gehört“), ganz am Anfang Indie-Pop („Wartezimmermusik“).
stil: relaxed modern neo-soul beat at 92 bpm: laid-back swung drums with a fat snare, round Fender bass, warm tape saturation, and the melody played on a clean electric guitar with slides and a little chorus, answered by a short muted trumpet phrase. The identity of the piece is ONE simple, singable six-note melody (a clear call-and-answer phrase) that a listener can hum after hearing it once; it is stated clearly up front and repeated. Modern, clean, uncluttered production, relaxed but uplifting Monday-morning mood, confident and cool, absolutely not stock music, not corporate, no generic ukulele or claps, instrumental only

stuecke.name: thema
stuecke.prompt: A 9-second podcast opening theme. Starts immediately, no intro build-up: the full beat and the melody from the first second, the melody stated twice, ending on one clear resolved final note with a short natural tail so a voice can start right after. No fade-in, no fade-out.

stuecke.name: outro
stuecke.prompt: A 12-second podcast outro. The same beat and exactly the same melody return, stated twice, then a short break and one clear resolved final note with a natural ending. No long fade.
